From 58189ca7b27411c3dc9a5cb9eeee0906da684c59 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: David Ahern <dsa@cumulusnetworks.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2015 15:10:50 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] net: Fix vti use case with oif in dst lookups

Steffen reported that the recent change to add oif to dst lookups breaks
the VTI use case. The problem is that with the oif set in the flow struct
the comparison to the nh_oif is triggered. Fix by splitting the
FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC into 2 flags -- one that triggers the vrf device cache
bypass (FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC) and another telling the lookup to not compare
nh oif (FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF).

Fixes: 42a7b32b73d6 ("xfrm: Add oif to dst lookups")

Signed-off-by: David Ahern <dsa@cumulusnetworks.com>
Acked-by: Steffen Klassert <steffen.klassert@secunet.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/ipv4/udp.c b/net/ipv4/udp.c
index c0a15e7f359f..f7d1d5e19e95 100644
--- a/net/ipv4/udp.c
+++ b/net/ipv4/udp.c
@@ -1024,7 +1024,8 @@ int udp_sendmsg(struct sock *sk, struct msghdr *msg, size_t len)
 		if (netif_index_is_vrf(net, ipc.oif)) {
 			flowi4_init_output(fl4, ipc.oif, sk->sk_mark, tos,
 					   RT_SCOPE_UNIVERSE, sk->sk_protocol,
-					   (flow_flags | FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC),
+					   (flow_flags | FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC |
+					    FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF),
 					   faddr, saddr, dport,
 					   inet->inet_sport);
 

diff --git a/net/ipv4/fib_trie.c b/net/ipv4/fib_trie.c
index 26d6ffb6d23c..6c2af797f2f9 100644
--- a/net/ipv4/fib_trie.c
+++ b/net/ipv4/fib_trie.c
@@ -1426,7 +1426,7 @@ int fib_table_lookup(struct fib_table *tb, const struct flowi4 *flp,
 			    nh->nh_flags & RTNH_F_LINKDOWN &&
 			    !(fib_flags & FIB_LOOKUP_IGNORE_LINKSTATE))
 				continue;
-			if (!(flp->flowi4_flags & FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC)) {
+			if (!(flp->flowi4_flags & FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF)) {
 				if (flp->flowi4_oif &&
 				    flp->flowi4_oif != nh->nh_oif)
 					continue;

diff --git a/drivers/net/vrf.c b/drivers/net/vrf.c
index e7094fbd7568..488c6f50df73 100644
--- a/drivers/net/vrf.c
+++ b/drivers/net/vrf.c
@@ -193,7 +193,8 @@ static netdev_tx_t vrf_process_v4_outbound(struct sk_buff *skb,
 		.flowi4_oif = vrf_dev->ifindex,
 		.flowi4_iif = LOOPBACK_IFINDEX,
 		.flowi4_tos = RT_TOS(ip4h->tos),
-		.flowi4_flags = FLOWI_FLAG_ANYSRC | FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC,
+		.flowi4_flags = FLOWI_FLAG_ANYSRC | FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC |
+				FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF,
 		.daddr = ip4h->daddr,
 	};
 

diff --git a/include/net/flow.h b/include/net/flow.h
index acd6a096250e..9b85db85f13c 100644
--- a/include/net/flow.h
+++ b/include/net/flow.h
@@ -35,6 +35,7 @@ struct flowi_common {
 #define FLOWI_FLAG_ANYSRC		0x01
 #define FLOWI_FLAG_KNOWN_NH		0x02
 #define FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC		0x04
+#define FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF		0x08
 	__u32	flowic_secid;
 	struct flowi_tunnel flowic_tun_key;
 };

diff --git a/net/ipv4/xfrm4_policy.c b/net/ipv4/xfrm4_policy.c
index bb919b28619f..c10a9ee68433 100644
--- a/net/ipv4/xfrm4_policy.c
+++ b/net/ipv4/xfrm4_policy.c
@@ -33,6 +33,8 @@ static struct dst_entry *__xfrm4_dst_lookup(struct net *net, struct flowi4 *fl4,
 	if (saddr)
 		fl4->saddr = saddr->a4;
 
+	fl4->flowi4_flags = FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF;
+
 	rt = __ip_route_output_key(net, fl4);
 	if (!IS_ERR(rt))
 		return &rt->dst;
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/include/net/route.h b/include/net/route.h
index cc61cb95f059..f46af256880c 100644
--- a/include/net/route.h
+++ b/include/net/route.h
@@ -255,7 +255,7 @@ static inline void ip_route_connect_init(struct flowi4 *fl4, __be32 dst, __be32
 		flow_flags |= FLOWI_FLAG_ANYSRC;
 
 	if (netif_index_is_vrf(sock_net(sk), oif))
-		flow_flags |= FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC;
+		flow_flags |= FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC | FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF;
 
 	flowi4_init_output(fl4, oif, sk->sk_mark, tos, RT_SCOPE_UNIVERSE,
 			   protocol, flow_flags, dst, src, dport, sport);

### Modifications in Each File

1. **`net/ipv4/udp.c`**
   - Modified the `udp_sendmsg` function to include the new flag `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` in the flow flags when initializing the flow structure for VRF devices.

2. **`net/ipv4/fib_trie.c`**
   - Changed the condition that checks for the `FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC` flag to check for `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` instead, ensuring that the nh_oif comparison is bypassed when this flag is set.

3. **`drivers/net/vrf.c`**
   - Updated the flow flags in the `vrf_process_v4_outbound` function to include `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` along with the existing flags.

4. **`include/net/flow.h`**
   - Added a new flag definition `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` to the flow flags enumeration.

5. **`net/ipv4/xfrm4_policy.c`**
   - Set the `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` flag in the flow structure during the destination lookup process.

6. **`include/net/route.h`**
   - Updated the `ip_route_connect_init` function to include `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` when the output interface is a VRF, in addition to the existing `FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications across the files are interconnected as they collectively address the issue reported regarding the VTI use case and the recent changes to destination lookups with output interface (oif). The introduction of the `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` flag allows the system to bypass the nh_oif comparison when necessary, thus preventing the breakage of the VTI functionality. 

- The new flag is defined in `include/net/flow.h` and is utilized in multiple files (`udp.c`, `vrf.c`, `xfrm4_policy.c`, and `route.h`) to ensure that the flow structure is correctly initialized and that the appropriate checks are performed during routing and policy lookups.
- The changes in `fib_trie.c` specifically ensure that the logic for handling the nh_oif comparison is correctly modified to respect the new flag, thereby maintaining the intended behavior of the routing logic when dealing with VRF devices. 

Overall, these modifications work together to fix the bug while maintaining the integrity of the routing and flow management systems in the kernel.

   - Similar to the previous file, the flow flags in the `udp_sendmsg` function were updated to include `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` along with `FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC`. This adjustment prevents nh_oif comparison during UDP message sending.

   - The flow flags in the `vrf_process_v4_outbound` function were also updated to include `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` alongside `FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC`. This ensures consistent behavior across VRF processing.

   - The `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF` flag was set in the `__xfrm4_dst_lookup` function to ensure that nh_oif comparison is bypassed during the destination lookup process.

5. **`net/ipv4/fib_trie.c`**
   - The condition checking for `FLOWI_FLAG_VRFSRC` was changed to check for `FLOWI_FLAG_SKIP_NH_OIF`. This modification alters the logic to skip nh_oif comparison when the new flag is set.

This change is consistently applied across various components of the networking stack, including routing, UDP processing, VRF handling, and flow management, ensuring that the new flag is respected wherever necessary. The introduction of the new flag and its usage in multiple functions demonstrates a cohesive approach to resolving the bug while maintaining the integrity of the existing functionality.
